result.title: Same Fix, Different Weights: Replicating Weight-Space Programming with Claude
result.summary: Takehi et al. (2026) report that GPT-6 Astra, given the weights of small neural networks as text, can say what they were trained to do, repair them, and write new ones without training. I re-ran the core of that study with Claude Opus 5.5 in ten pre-registered experiments, with untrained-network and permutation controls and hand audits of every sandboxed code cell. Reading was mixed: Claude named 3 of 4 Atari games from policy weights and found the measured copying heads in 15/15 character-LM runs, but its answers about training data often followed priors. Unlike the original, it identified a sycophantic Gemma 3 270M finetune from weights alone in 6/6 runs. One-shot weight edits took a failing MountainCar policy from 0% to 100% success and a hovering LunarLander policy from 0% to 85.6%; zero-shot networks beat PPO at 100k steps on 4 of 5 environments, each implementing a textbook controller. With no training or forward passes, Claude wrote a 1.48M-parameter 9x9 Go network that won 85-94% of games against three PPO opponents. Given Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights and 10, 25 or 50 forward passes of 64 practice problems, Claude raised MATH-500 from 6.7% to 51.4%, 55.2% and 58.1% (+51.4 points at 50 passes, 95% CI [47.9, 55.0]; original 48.1%), GSM8K from 11.6% to 68.2% and IFEval from 22.2% to 54.2%. Unlike the original, which removed an internal loop direction, every edit acted at the output: it scaled the final norm, raising the effective sampling temperature, and lowered the logit of "Wait" while raising that of </think>. The norm scaling alone reaches only 20.9-22.1% on MATH-500. On Gemma 3 270M, which rarely loops, no edit helped (-0.8 points), as in the original.

AI.brief_summary: 该文用 Claude Opus 5.5 复现「权重作为文本」的 weight-space programming：十项预注册实验检验仅凭权重说出网络功能、一次性修复失败策略并零训练写出新网络，并配有未训练网络与置换对照及代码人工审查。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其关键对照——修改并未触及内部循环方向、而是通过缩放 final norm 和压低「Wait」logit 在输出端生效——可能为 LVR 中区分「真正改变 latent 状态」与「仅改变读出/采样行为」的因果归因提供类比线索，可供核查。
